answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 41128 Country: Bangladesh Title: Reading quran in chair Question: Is it right to read the holy Quran sitting on a chair? Answer ID: 41128 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1291/857/H=1433) It is allowable but it is better that it is recited sitting on the land owing to its respect and solemnity. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
